title: Indawo Yokuphumula Yodwa
intro: Ezincwadini zomusa kaNkulunkulu, kukhona umphefumulo omsulwa ongenakuqhathaniswa, ohlukanisiwe nabantu bawo ukuze afune ukuba yedwa endaweni engcwele. Babengazi ukuthi lokhu kuzihlukanisa kuzoletha isibonakaliso sawo wonke umhlaba, isivivinyo sokholo okwakuzokhulunywa ngaso kuze kube phakade.
clues: Ngangizinikele empilweni yokukhonza ngaphambi kokuzalwa kwami.
Ngasekelwa ukudla okuvela ku-Allah okwamangaza umnakekeli wami.
Ngazihlukanisa nomndeni wami ngaya endaweni esempumalanga.
Ingelosi yabonakala kimi ngesimo somuntu ophelele, iletha izindaba zendodana emsulwa.
Lapho ngibuya nosana lwami olusanda kuzalwa, abantu bakithi bangimangalela, kodwa usana lwakhuluma lungivikela.
arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verse: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east. (19:16)
